title: Strangely smaller than they should be
text: Strangely smaller than they should be. As replacement tops, they are a challenge to get on the original glass pyrex containers they are meant to match up with. Even right out of the wrapper they look to be a tad smaller than they should. Sure enough it a struggle to get them on. Will they stretch with repeated use? Who knows!
